cause_prs.author: BBuf
cause_prs.title: [Refactor] kernels/diffusion/tests: Prune dead code and fix tests that never ran

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
The 4 tests that go through the new `setUp` fail with `AttributeError: … object has no attribute 'enterContext'` (line 53). The 5th test in the file passes.

The rocm720 lane runs `/opt/venv/lib/python3.10`. The same file passes 5/5 on the Python 3.12 lanes: [J rocm724 (1)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39295915056/job/118208349678) and [I rocm10 (1)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39251834478/job/118237630446).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: [`329072d9`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/329072d99a7e150d72ba0731066525269b61b843) ([#44690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44690), merged Oct 19 00:55 UTC) added `setUp()` → `self.enterContext(patch(...))`. `unittest.TestCase.enterContext` exists only in Python 3.11 and later. J is the first rocm720 run that includes this commit.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: (none found).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. I searched `enterContext`, `test_usp_ring_replicated` and `usp ring replicated`; the only hit, [#44400](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44400), is unrelated.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: on a branch, replace the call with `self.addCleanup(p.stop)` after `p.start()` (Python 3.10-safe), then rerun shard (1) on rocm720.

cause_prs.author: hnyls2002
cause_prs.title: [CI] test-utils: Abort the test run when its server dies inside a `CustomTestCase` method

fix_prs.author: alphabetc1
fix_prs.title: [Fix] test-utils: Allow expected server exits in canary tests

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: first failure is today (N19), on all 3 lanes. The test passed on Oct 18. The crash dump is written correctly; then the watcher calls `os._exit` before the test's assertions run.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: [`299da601`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/299da60131dbbd9d3be0e1b2463b1f82cd984729) ([#45053](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45053), merged 01:00 UTC) added the watcher that prints this exact `[FIXTURE FAIL-FAST]` string.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: `test_soft_watchdog.py` also exercises server-failure paths and still passes. Why it is unaffected is not verified.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ⚠️ partial. [#45172](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45172) (open since Oct 19, `blocked`) adds an `expect_server_exit` opt-out but does not opt `TestCrashDump` in.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: on a branch, add `expect_server_exit = True` to `TestCrashDump` on top of #45172, then rerun on `linux-mi300-1gpu-sglang`.
